model.name: Qwen/Qwen3-4B
model.revision_policy: frozen from extra development run (model.config._commit_hash on Kaggle T4); use this sha for Stage C

precision.inference: float16 on T4 (sm < 8.0); bfloat16 only if a later replication uses Ampere+
precision.alignment: float32 (released ModelWrapper already builds the realignment matrix and applies it in float32)
precision.compression: float32 for OBF QR/SVD/Gram and residual injection (released HOBF/HOBFFast already cast values to float32, then write back in the cache dtype)
precision.do_not: cast the whole process, including alignment and OBF, to float16

decoding.inventory: greedy one-line answers, max_new_tokens 48; document difference from the paper's T=0.6, top_p=0.95 sampling

stage_a.purpose: confirm the pipeline executes, including alignment-matrix construction and OBF; not a reproduction of paper accuracy

sensitivity.note: held-out no-filler check because development filler changed the eviction penalty and the OBF gap

main_comparison.h3: skipped; no reservation rule was frozen on development
main_comparison.lead: sender-only accuracy vs actual relay size for eviction and OBF; shared panel is interpretive

evidence_selection_diagnostic.note: Diagnostic intervention on development examples. Force the complete relevant inventory line inside the existing 32-slot budget, then fill remaining slots with the original attention rule. Unrelated-line control reserves the same number of slots. Not a proposed compressor. Leave OBF unchanged. Do not generate a new held-out set until this is interpreted.

practical_selection.question: Can we automatically obtain the accuracy recovery demonstrated by evidence-preserving selection, at the same relay budget and with little additional computation?
practical_selection.probe: one forward pass of B's question and choices on A's full cache; discard new KV; rank original prompt positions. Simulated at the sender. Extra time is compute, not communication.
practical_selection.question_match: parse the package name from the question and keep that complete inventory line. Does not use the gold locker or record index. This format makes exact-name matching unusually easy.
practical_selection.oracle: known relevant line on the same cache; ceiling, not a method

fresh_validation.question: Does the development recovery generalize to fresh examples, and does it depend on probing the correct package rather than a generic or recency effect?
fresh_validation.claim: On 20 development examples, question-informed selectors recovered full-relay-level accuracy at roughly one-fifth of the relay size, without using answer labels. We will investigate when this recovery generalizes and which cached representations make it possible.

question_withheld.question_match: parse the package from B's question and keep that complete inventory line; no gold locker or record index
question_withheld.scoring: shared extractor is primary for every method; correct_legacy keeps the original first-match rule
question_withheld.question: In the withheld-question setting, does simple record matching recover accuracy as cheaply as the correct-question probe?

text_baseline.message: UTF-8 bytes of the matched fact sentence, e.g. Package Luma is in locker 7.
text_baseline.compare_from: existing results_stage_practical on the same 20 development examples
text_baseline.note: Development check, not new held-out evidence. Tests whether B needs the latent KV message for this one-record lookup.

hop_two_record.question: On a two-record lookup, does question-probed KV beat practical text (iterative retrieval or sender-generated summary)?

study_0_plan.objective: Choose the lowest-cost carrier that satisfies all operational requirements and does not exceed the budget.
study_0_plan.oracle_wrapper: same as collab_text; only the message body changes
study_0_plan.extra_compute: planning pass on B's information only, then a final-answer pass

paired_interventions.a_flip: change only A's operational facts so the gold carrier changes
paired_interventions.b_flip: change only B's prices so the gold carrier changes

study_0_plan.oracle: evaluator eligibility set supplied to B with the same receiver wrapper as collab_text; not used to build ordinary A messages
study_0_plan.question: Does this joint plan-selection task measure collaboration, rather than a single-agent shortcut?
study_0_plan.note: Development check. Do not drop individual failures. If capability is poor, revise the generator on this split. Do not write plan_test until this is interpreted.

study_0_diag.b_design: 2 oracle message formats x 2 receiver procedures
study_0_diag.reason_pass: uses eligibility message and prices; not b_extra_compute
study_0_diag.question: After removing answer-bearing A templates, can A label eligibility, and can B use a correct oracle message if the format or a short reasoning pass changes?
study_0_diag.note: Small diagnostic. Same examples and objective. Keep every result. Not Study 1.

study_0_e2e.message: A generated compact eligibility; not the evaluator oracle
study_0_e2e.question: When B uses reason-then-answer on A's actual compact message, does collaboration transfer on a small fresh development set?
study_0_e2e.note: One end-to-end check. Keep every result. Do not retune prompts. Not Study 1.

study_1.channel: text and full KV; compression deferred
study_1.source_evidence: A-generated facts from an independent C0 copy; not the hop hardcoded retriever
study_1.delta_kv: Accuracy(full relay from C40) - Accuracy(full relay from C0)
study_1.delta_text: Accuracy(text generated from C40) - Accuracy(text generated from C0)
study_1.interpretation: additional latent processing versus no additional rollout; C0 already includes read-time computation
study_1.compression: deferred until uncompressed full-relay behavior is understood; two budgets later
study_1.length_controls: optional diagnostics after the basic comparison; not a clean same-length zero-computation condition
study_1.question: Does additional sender processing produce a useful downstream benefit, and does that benefit survive text versus full KV handoff?

study_plan4_cal.oracle_target: around 90% B accuracy with correct intermediates; diagnostic, not a validity proof
study_plan4_cal.question: Which difficulty levels require additional sender computation before a six-condition communication comparison?
study_plan4_cal.note: First calibration complete. Written condition did not produce working. Do not resume this folder.

study_plan4_diag.written_path: ordinary concatenated generation; working then RESULTS block
study_plan4_diag.direct_latent_path: cached continuation; handoff is a new chat turn
study_plan4_diag.cache_compare: ordinary one-turn vs cached continuation on compact and written
study_plan4_diag.eligibility_rule: sufficient capacity AND required refrigeration AND available driver
study_plan4_diag.b_procedure: list feasible prices, name cheapest, Answer must match that name
study_plan4_diag.question: Does separating written working from the RESULTS block actually produce calculations, and does ordinary generation match cached continuation?
study_plan4_diag.rescored: parse_diagnostics.json; missing plan extraction is not disagreement; **RESULTS** counts; optional q= is a parsing diagnostic

study_plan4_cachecheck.question: On one token sequence, does a cached prefix plus continuation match full generation?
study_plan4_cachecheck.note: All three matched. Matching text is not correctness and does not validate latent-40, compression, or full handoff.

study_plan4_bprompt.question: On all development families, does a one-line-per-carrier B plan beat the previous brief plan when the message is correct?
study_plan4_bprompt.note: Keep the line prompt. Stop B-prompt tuning. 80/90 is a correct-message reference, not a ceiling.

study_plan4_chain.a_path: ordinary one-turn written calculations; B receives RESULTS lines only
deferred: text vs full KV vs two compressed KV budgets
study_plan4_chain.question: When A writes the calculations and B uses the frozen line plan, does collaboration beat no-message and mismatch, and how close is it to the 80/90 oracle reference?
study_plan4_chain.note: Freeze task and prompts. Collaboration is established on text. Do not resume this folder.

study_plan4_comm.a_path: ordinary written calculations on every branch; not latent-40
study_plan4_comm.text: four RESULT lines from that written output
study_plan4_comm.kv: full KV cache after the same written generation
study_plan4_comm.b_prompt: frozen line-by-line; KV uses relayed-memory wording
deferred: two compressed KV budgets after this full relay is interpretable
fresh split after the procedure is settled
study_plan4_comm.question: When A writes the calculations once, does full KV of that completed state beat sending the four RESULT lines as text?
study_plan4_comm.note: Full KV works. Modest accuracy edge, much larger payload, no speed benefit. Do not resume this folder.

study_plan4_compress.a_path: ordinary written calculations on every branch; not latent-40
study_plan4_compress.text_full: A operational sheet plus already-written calculations; no extra A generation
study_plan4_compress.budget_scope: entire completed cache (prompt + written tokens); sink 4 plus kv_budget selected per head; no reserved latent tail
study_plan4_compress.b_prompt: frozen line-by-line; KV uses relayed-memory wording

study_plan4_compress.question: Does additional text context explain the KV-versus-concise-text gap, and how much of full-KV accuracy remains at headwise budgets 32 and 64?
study_plan4_compress.selector: dummy last-query token over the completed cache
study_plan4_compress.note: Dummy-token headwise collapsed to the mismatch range. Diagnoses the selector, not question-conditioned compression. Do not resume this folder.

study_plan4_probe.budget_scope: entire completed cache (prompt + written tokens); sink 4 plus kv_budget selected per head; no reserved latent tail

study_plan4_probe.b_prompt: frozen line-by-line; KV uses relayed-memory wording
deferred: fresh split after the budget check
study_plan4_probe.question: Does a meaningful receiver request recover compressed-KV accuracy at budgets 32 and 64, and does OBF recover information after that same selection?
study_plan4_probe.timing_summary: averages recorded process_time_s; older helper omitted probe/compression
study_plan4_probe.note: Question-conditioned 32/64 did not rescue compression. OBF had no net accuracy gain. Do not resume this folder.

study_plan4_budget.a_path: ordinary written calculations on every branch; not latent-40
study_plan4_budget.probe: capacity, eligibility, and shipment conditions; no prices or budget

study_plan4_budget.budget_scope: entire completed cache (prompt + written tokens); sink 4 plus kv_budget selected per head; no reserved latent tail

study_plan4_budget.note: More space helped (41/90 vs 29/90 at 64) but did not restore reliable collaboration. Stop increasing budgets on plan4_dev. Do not resume this folder.

study_plan4_fresh.a_path: ordinary written calculations on every branch; not latent-40
study_plan4_fresh.text: four RESULT lines from the written output

study_plan4_fresh.note: Full KV did not beat text on this split. Probe-256 stayed far below text. Collaboration controls still drop. Do not resume this folder.

study_plan4_span.a_path: ordinary written calculations on every branch; not latent-40

study_plan4_span.note: Result-only KV collapsed to repeated thinking tags. Probe selected chat markers, not result lines. Remaining full-KV and result-text errors are often choice failures after correct eligibility. Do not resume this folder.
